digest.component_or_area: rich text codec cutover + state-based echo suppression
propositions: Cloud and DC send paths must cut over to rich codecs (e59d, 271c) with echo suppression via state-based baseline comparison, reusing ADR-0026 baseline-diff logic without post-push GET
DC codec is one-way lossy; normalize_outbound must be redefined as decode_inbound(to_wire(t)) to restore codec law, enabling once-only re-emit convergence

Two distinct compares must remain: emit-side compares normalized local vs inbound-decoded remote; baseline-side compares local through normalize_outbound vs decode(baseline_wire) to cancel lossy round-trip
Local origin-gating via inline change-gated rich_sha (8 bytes, 0.07 KB/version) ensures updates fire only on rebar-originated changes (local != baseline), not benign re-canonicalization
Concurrent both-sides edit keeps local-wins body and raises existing outbound-field-conflict alert; legacy bodies upgrade exactly once then converge
Cutover must tolerate missing marklas extra by lazily importing and falling back to plain-text ADF, degrading gracefully without raising or emitting half-converted wire
